title: Murals & Mimosas Tour
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Operates in all weather conditions, please dress appropriately.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Kickstart your day diving into Nashville’s hippest neighborhoods to see popular murals, pose for the best pics, and top it off with a mimosa and small bites. Grab your friends and a camera—this mural sightseeing tour with sweets and sips is not to be missed. Whatever the occasion, this tour makes parties easy since all planning, coordinating, and transportation are handled.

Travel to multiple eclectic Music City areas with an expert guide to see street art and wall murals. Snap pics at top spots on this three-hour tour, plus one stop for mimosas and bites!

Itinerary
- Depart from the Omni in Downtown Nashville near Rep. John Lewis Way South. Feel free to BYOB for the bus. (21+, please drink responsibly.)

- Sightseeing Murals Tour
Explore neighborhoods like downtown, the Gulch, & Capital View. Guests see 10+ murals and get out to take photos at many stops. Includes one stop for a drink and snack at a local Nashville spot.

- Return to the Omni in Downtown Nashville.
